name: God's Pantry Food Bank of Southeast Kentucky
description: Regional food bank distribution center serving Southeast Kentucky. Part of the God's Pantry network distributing to 200+ pantries across Central and Eastern Kentucky. Opened London location in 2013.
eligibility: Individuals and families in need. Pantry partner organizations in the service area.

cross_references.findings: London listed as 'Southeast Regional Distribution Center'. Address matches. Phone: main HQ 859-255-6592, London-specific number not on their site.
Address: 1215 East 4th Street, London, KY 40741. Phone: 606-862-6693. Hours: Mon-Fri 7a-3:30p.
1,573 likes. 'Fighting Hunger | Delivering Hope | Since 1955'. Confirms organization identity.

notes: DISTRIBUTION CENTER (warehouse), not a walk-in pantry. Distributes TO partner pantries. Individuals should use godspantry.org/help to find a pantry. Phone 606-862-6693 confirmed by Health Dept and third-party listings but not on godspantry.org.
